gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-asap: Shantell Sans has a wide, tin-can mouth and diagonals just as thick as its uprights, giving it a hand-drawn, one-nib look. Expressiveness comes from the heading, while Asap supplies readable, low-key text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Shantell Sans looks hand-inked, its mouths wide and its nib never changing. The heading is best at personality, while Be Vietnam Pro, with bent-steel strokes and a high mean line, is best at steady text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-epilogue: Epilogue draws curvy, unclamped letters on a wire-like monoline skeleton, its lowercase large with stubby ascender tips. And across a full page, the sans text moves along friendly and steady beneath Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-merriweather-san: Distinctive, wide-mouthed lettering: Shantell Sans keeps one constant stroke from top to baseline. But Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, large-looking words and an e that opens clearly right, grounding the page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-supreme: Expressive from the first letter, Shantell Sans keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. Supreme then lays down a crisp, heavy-looking strip of text beneath.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, and its curves glide along unobstructed. But Shantell Sans, with its fixed nib width, carries the distinctive voice up top.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-orbit: Shantell Sans is wide-mouthed and drawn with one fixed nib width. It handles personality best, while Orbit, with rope-like consistency and curves that stop short of closing, handles steady text best.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-science-gothic: Shantell Sans brings an expressive hand, its nib fixed and its mouths wide. And Science Gothic, stroke ends set far apart, reads a paragraph one letter at a time.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-switzer: Distinctive and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans is best at personality, its nib width never shifting. Switzer, with tubular wire-like forms and a high waist line, is best at Swiss-minded text.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-asap: Terminals that stop short of curling back give Sniglet a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. Asap, with open-arc c forms and a body height near the capitals, keeps paragraph after paragraph readable.
